  • Method Details

    • registerUser

      public User registerUser(String username, String email, String password, Role role)
      Registers a new user.
      Parameters:
      username - unique username (3-30 chars, alphanumeric + underscore)
      email - unique valid email address
      password - strong password meeting security requirements
      role - user role (defaults to CUSTOMER if null)
      Returns:
      created User entity
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if inputs are invalid or username/email already taken

    • authenticate

      public User authenticate(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a user by username and password. Failed attempts are tracked; after 3 consecutive failures, the account is locked.
      Parameters:
      username - user username
      password - user password
      Returns:
      authenticated User
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if username or password is null or blank
      AuthenticationException - if username not found or password incorrect
      AccountLockedException - if account is locked

    • changePassword

      public void changePassword(String userId, String oldPassword, String newPassword)
      Updates user password after verifying the old password.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      oldPassword - current password
      newPassword - new password meeting complexity criteria
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if user does not exist
      AuthenticationException - if old password does not match
      ValidationException - if new password is weak or matches old password

      Throws:

      public void unlockUser(String userId)

    • hasPermission

      public boolean hasPermission(String userId, String permission)
      Checks if a user has a specific permission. Role hierarchy: - ADMIN: all permissions - MANAGER: "READ", "WRITE", "MANAGE_INVENTORY", "MANAGE_ORDERS" - CUSTOMER: "READ", "CREATE_ORDER", "VIEW_OWN_PROFILE" - GUEST: "READ"
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      permission - permission string
      Returns:
      true if permitted, false otherwise
